Define original first-layer branch activations a=linear(rawSummary*originalRawScale,Wr), b=linear(physSummary*originalPhysScale,Wf), original h=GELU(a+b+bias). Add h_new=h+0.25*tanh(g_raw)*norm_raw(GELU(a+bias/2))+0.25*tanh(g_feature)*norm_feature(GELU(b+bias/2)). qualification: First, mean FULL-B0 AUROC strictly positive and AP/MacroF1/EZF1 each>=-0.01; at least2/3seeds individually have AUROC>0 and the other3differences>=-0.01. Second, for EACH of FULL-WO_FEATURE_PR and FULL-WO_RAW_PR, mean AUROC andMacroF1 BOTH strictly positive and at least2/3seeds have BOTH positive. Third, apply the same two-endpoint positive/2seed rule to FULL-CHANNEL_CONTEXT. All three requirements must pass to qualify only for a separate core-module study. These are fixed engineering point rules, not significance or formal noninferiority. Zero-crossing intervals cannot support a stable statistically positive claim. No gate relaxation, better-control promotion or additional candidate after new assessment.
